entity.title: Candidate E-mail
entity.description: The candidate's e-mail address as a contact channel record, linked to the candidate by HasContact and used to find duplicates.

candidate.title: Candidate
candidate.description: The candidate who owns this e-mail address, linked by HasContact.

capabilities.read.byId: Reads the candidate's e-mail record by id so the candidate screen and application lists can show the address.
capabilities.locate.byContact: Finds the e-mail record holding a typed address so the recruiter detects an already registered candidate before creating a new one.
capabilities.register.createOrAttach: Creates the e-mail record when the address is new, or attaches the hiringPipeline.CandidateEmail role to the existing one, when the recruiter registers a candidate.
capabilities.edit.platformFields: Lets the recruiter correct a mistyped address or mark it verified.
capabilities.inactivate: Lets the recruiter take an address the candidate no longer uses out of service without deleting it, and reactivate it later.
capabilities.link: Links the e-mail to its candidate through HasContact when the recruiter registers or updates the candidate.
capabilities.unlink: Closes the HasContact link when the recruiter removes an address from a candidate, keeping its history.
capabilities.listLinks: Shows on the e-mail record which candidate it belongs to, for the recruiter and the hiring manager.
capabilities.audit: Shows an administrator who changed a candidate's e-mail and when.
